correctness.rationale: For q>=2, overlap directed graph on q² ordered pairs has one directed edge for every triple with exactly two equal letters (3q(q−1) edges). Diagonal vertices have in/out q−1, off-diagonal in/out 2; diagonal-to-diagonal two-step routes and transitions show strong connectivity. An Eulerian circuit corresponds bijectively to a cyclic universal word; anchoring the unique 001 edge selects one rotation with no extra divisor. Directed BEST counts anchored tours as rooted in-arborescence tau times ((q−2)!)^q. The outgoing Laplacian off-diagonal block is 2I−R with determinant 3^binom(q,2) and inverse (2I+R)/3; Schur complement of diagonal block is (2/3)(qI−J), rooted cofactor q^(q−2). Thus tau=2^(q−1)3^((q−1)(q−2)/2)q^(q−2), giving U=tau((q−2)!)^q. Each symbol is in first position of 3(q−1) triples, hence occurs that often. Independently computed exact rooted cofactors q=2..5 (tau=2,36,3456,1458000) and small count consistency. All-q proof is determinant identity, not finite tests.
